name: Minatori Yukari
source:
The wife of the president of a famous trading company.

Originally a daughter of a wealthy family, she and her husband had an arranged marriage. She has no money problems, and her husband travels abroad almost all year round, so she has a lot of free time on her hands.

She is tolerant in all things, but faithful to her desires. She doesn't mind cheating on her husband, saying that it's just for fun and he does it too.

[From [url=https://amusecraft.com/strikes/index2.htm]official site[/url]]
